label: truncated is the harness's own flag: no EOS within the generation cap. The detector only sees text.

operating_point.selection_rule: maximise detection rate on truncated answers subject to false-positive rate <= 0.05 on finished answers, a compression effect of at least 20% and a repetition rate of at least 20%

reading: These thresholds are a claim about text, not about correctness. A legitimate repeated operation can trip the period branch; the false-positive rate is measured on finished stage-1 answers and printed here. Accuracy conditioned on termination uses each raw row's own `flexible_correct` (sample level; for maj@16 this is not the vote), so it is comparable across checkpoints with the same eval receipt. The eval receipt itself reports the same block per task, mode and decoding, with the receipt's scored verdict, beside the unchanged decoding.
